The first plot, titled "Easy Training Set," illustrates the training rewards over a series of steps for two different methods: "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" and "Llama-LUFFY-Easy." The x-axis, labeled "Steps," is linear and ranges from 0 to 500, with tick labels at every 100 steps. The y-axis, labeled "Training Rewards," is also linear and ranges from 0.0 to 0.4, with tick labels at every 0.2 interval. The "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" line is blue with a solid line style, while the "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" line is red with a solid line style. Both lines show a general upward trend, with the "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" line starting slightly higher and ending slightly lower than the "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" line. The "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" line has a wider confidence interval, indicating more variability in the training rewards.

The second plot, titled "Hard Training Set," depicts the training rewards for the same two methods but in a more challenging scenario. The x-axis is the same as the first plot, labeled "Steps" and ranging from 0 to 500, with tick labels at every 100 steps. The y-axis, labeled "Training Rewards," ranges from 0.0 to 0.2, with tick labels at every 0.1 interval. The "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" line is blue with a solid line style, and the "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" line is red with a solid line style. Both lines show a more volatile trend with several peaks and troughs. The "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" line starts lower, fluctuates more, and ends slightly higher than the "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" line. The confidence intervals are also wider, suggesting greater variability in the training rewards.
